name: Anamaria P.
text: From the street, you can only see the bar area, but the restaurant opens up beautifully inside. The interior features an open kitchen, a comfortable seating area with three elegant velvet booths, and plenty of additional tables.

name: Milena M.
text: Amazing food! The calm atmosphere and a great service really provide a full experience. We enjoyed it and will be back soon!

name: Alex B.
text: The French Syrah Grenache is super smooth. The reduction and mashed potatoes was delicious. The John Dori fish was good. The chocolate mousse was delicious. Service impeccable.
